title: Delegation result summary heuristic reads a path:line number after a finding noun ('error at lib.rs:42') as a finding count
outcome: Pre-existing and out of scope of w-a7c465026c6c. In src/delegation_result_parser.rs the summary heuristic splits on punctuation, so 'parser.rs:308' becomes 'parser rs 308'. A number preceded by a file-extension token then counts as a finding count near a finding noun. A clean packet whose summary says, for example, 'Note the error at lib.rs:42 is expected' with Findings: None still gains a synthesized 'Unspecified' finding. Fix direction: treat a number preceded by a file-extension token (rs, ts, tsx, md, json, …), or originally joined by ':', as a location, mirroring the path-like prose guard for structured findings.
acceptance: Delegation result summary heuristic reads a path:line number after a finding noun ('error at lib.rs:42') as a finding count is done
